title: The First Atomic Bomb Turned Desert Sand Into Green Glass

scenes.text: One bomb turned a desert into green glass.
July 16, 1945. The first atomic bomb was tested in New Mexico.
The heat was over 2,600 degrees Fahrenheit, hot enough to melt sand.
Scientists think sand was pulled into the fireball and rained back down molten.
It cooled into a green glass called trinitite, after only a few seconds.

description:
One bomb turned a desert into green glass.
The Trinity test on July 16, 1945 melted the sand of New Mexico into a green glass now called trinitite. The ground stayed molten for only a few seconds, and the glass is still mildly radioactive.
Would you keep a piece? Comment below.
